elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added sentence applies "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason."
Kubient "shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance."

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause provides assistance for at least 90 days but does not require availability for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Kubient's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state any rates or pricing for transition assistance.

elements.element: Kubient must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must "export and deliver to Customer all data of Customer in Kubient's possession or control."

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires export and delivery but does not specify a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Export and delivery are required "within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination."

elements.element: Kubient must certify deletion of Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification is required. The original return-or-destroy provision concerns Confidential Information and provides no certification duty.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added sentence expressly applies upon either expiry or termination.
Kubient is required to provide reasonable transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires assistance "for at least ninety (90) days," which covers the required 90-day period.

elements.element: Kubient must export Customer data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must "export and deliver to Customer all data of Customer in Kubient's possession or control."

elements.element: Customer data must be exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export and delivery deadline is thirty days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The redline fully implements the fallback by requiring at least 90 days of transition assistance and export and delivery of Customer data within 30 days following expiry or termination. It does not achieve the preferred position because it omits six-month availability, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, and certification of deletion. The amendment is targeted and does not materially disturb unrelated commercial terms, although drafting quality is reduced by making assistance conditional on Customer request and by leaving the endpoint of an "at least" 90-day assistance period open-ended.
